headline: 歪心狼撞狂热先生，今日影视双热
summary: 今日电影热作《歪心狼对阵ACME》领跑影院，新剧《狂热先生》首播吸睛；《龙族》等热播剧持续霸屏，待播片单亦引发期待。

industryHighlights.text: 电影《歪心狼对阵ACME》本周领跑院线，《坠落2：死点》同步热映。
industryHighlights.en: Wile E. Coyote vs. ACME leads this week's theaters, with Fall 2: Deadpoint also now playing.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《狂热先生》首播，加入与《龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》等的热播剧竞争。
industryHighlights.en: New drama Mr. Fanatic premieres, joining hits like House of the Dragon and Rick and Morty.

industryHighlights.text: 多部剧集和电影已列入待播/待映名单，后续内容储备丰富。
industryHighlights.en: A rich pipeline of upcoming series and films is already on the release slate.

headlineEn: Coyote vs. ACME meets Mr. Fanatic as movies and TV heat up
summaryEn: Movie highlight Wile E. Coyote vs. ACME leads theaters, while new series Mr. Fanatic debuts; House of the Dragon keeps dominating TV, with a strong upcoming slate ahead.
